title: Zesty Spicy Irish Chinese Long Beans Wrap
description: A spicy and crumbly Irish dish featuring Chinese long beans, wrapped in leaves and steamed to perfection, friendly to sugar-free diets. This nostalgic dish combines the best of Irish and Chinese flavors.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Irish sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Chinese long beans and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce and season with salt and black pepper.
Lay a leaf wrap flat and spoon about 1/2 cup of the bean and sausage mixture onto the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining leaves and filling.
Place the wraps in a steamer basket and steam over boiling water for 10 minutes.
